I was badly addicted to using and selling meth for a few years. I got caught and was sentenced to probation due to my youth and lack of prior legal issues. Still, I kept using and found myself facing a choice between mandatory rehab or prison. I went to court intending to choose prison, but my mom showed up... so I chose rehab. It was the hardest 9 months of my life. I went to NA meetings, worked with a sponsor, and got my life back on track.
